props.title: Frequently Asked Questions
props.subtitle: Find answers to the questions we hear most often.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Reach out through our contact page and our team will guide you through the next steps.

items.question: What areas do you serve?
items.answer: We serve customers across Bangladesh through our dealer and support network.

items.question: How can I get support?
items.answer: Visit the Contact Us page for phone, email, and office details, and our team will respond promptly.

items.question: Do you offer guidance after purchase?
items.answer: Yes, our support team is available to help with any questions after you start using our products or services.

props.title: Still have questions?
props.subtitle: Get in touch and we'll be happy to help.
